name: Downtown 23 C 1BDR
headline: Marrakesh 1BDR w/ Jacuzzi Terrace @ Downtown Cairo (23C)
summary: This Moroccan themed studio is located at the heart of Downtown Cairo, 250 meters away from the iconic Tahrir Square. The studio is an 8 min walk from the Egyptian Museum and is surrounded with all kinds of restaurants and cafes. The studio apartment features a comfortable queen size bed, an outdoor terrace with a Jacuzzi! , a 32 inch smart TV, cozy bathroom and a fully loaded kitchenette.

description.Space:
The Moroccan themed studio features a queen size comfortable bed and a breathtaking terrace with a Jacuzzi! It also features a fully loaded kitchenette, microwave, a stove top with cooking utensils, a kettle and a Nespresso coffee machine. Additionally, guests can enjoy a 32inch smart TV for further personal entertainment. 

Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed in the balcony or outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests an authentic oriental experience themed with a Moroccan vibe.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.

- Cairo International Airport is a 35 minute drive.
- Giza Pyramids is a 35 minute drive

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

The room looks exactly like pictures and the hot tub was fantastic. It was a really comfortable stay, However it felt smaller in person that what it looks like in the pictures. Though for a couple, this was manageable. The hot tub and terrace were extremely dusty and required a lot of self cleaning before we were able to use it, however the area is generally dusty, so I can imagine it’s very hard for them to keep it consistently free of dirt and dust. I really enjoyed my stay, but just something to keep in mind and give them tolerance with.

The good: the bed was very comfortable, clean sheets and linen. Pillows were great, and I slept soundly. The location is superb, and there were several nice local restaurants in the area. It wasn’t super touristy, but walking distance to the tourist/sight seeing spots which we appreciated. The communication with Xuru Stays was top notch and they were always there for any questions or concerns we had. Id stay with them again just for how on top of it they were. 

The bad: the terrace was really dusty and the jacuzzi needed self cleaning before we could use it, but in all fairness Cairo is extremely dusty so even though it had been cleaned the day of, expect to need to clean it again if you want to use the area. The room was a bit on the smaller side, it does look bigger in the pictures. *However*, it was enough space for my partner and I, especially taking into consideration the size of the terrace and jacuzzi (which we used twice in our 4 night stay). 

Things to take into consideration: there is a stove to cook on with pans provided and cutlery, however the room is small and I wouldn’t recommend planning on cooking all of your meals here. Instead, there are a lot of great restaurants in the area that are extremely well priced. 

Overall, the jacuzzi was a really nice addition to the studio and made the entire stay + cost worth it. My partner and I appreciate the nicer things in life, however do not like to over spend. We found that this room perfectly fit our needs. I would 100% stay here again without a doubt.

The room itself was great -- clean, and right in the heart of the city of Cairo. If you've never been to Egypt -- just know that they honk their horns in their cars as a form of communication. This really never ends, so you will hear cars honking their horns 24/7. They also have prayer at 4:30am, so you will hear the prayer over the loud speaker in the city at 4:30am while you're trying to sleep. My husband and I didn't really feel super safe leaving the room on our own. We did a food tour with a guide one night, which was great -- but we would have never done it on our own. Having private tour guides is definitely the way to go. I would most definitely stay in a regular hotel if we ever travel to Egypt again.

Let me list it below: 
1. We experienced planned blackouts every night meaning that hot water, light and AC were not working. The possibility of those was not mentioned anywhere in the description of the property. When we enquired about moving us to a different property or for a refund we were ignored as was booking.com CS. This means that if you have any problem with the property they will not reply or take care of the problems. 
2. The boiler broke on the last day and straight up stopped working. The water was either boiling hot or super cold throughout our stay even when it *was* working.  
3. I can’t overestimate how much noise was coming from the street. The windows have no insulation.  

In short, spend a bit more money and get a hotel room or a reliable airbnb. We had fantastic stay in Cairo and picking this property was our only mistake.

Le logement était agréable dans l’ensemble, mais j’ai été déçu(e) par la propreté de la terrasse, qui aurait vraiment besoin d’un bon nettoyage. De plus, il manquait des équipements de base pour cuisiner, ce qui a compliqué un peu le séjour. Enfin, l’absence de penderie ou d’espace pour ranger les vêtements était assez gênante. Ces points pourraient être améliorés pour rendre l’expérience plus confortable.

Points positifs :
	•	Studio propre et joliment décoré
	•	Bien situé, isolé des bruits de rue
	•	Gardien agréable, et réponses rapides aux messages

Points négatifs :
	•	Manque total d’intimité : des hommes sur les balcons voisins observent constamment la terrasse/jacuzzi toute la journée, très gênant
	•	Un seul jeu de serviettes pour plusieurs jours avec jacuzzi : insuffisant
	•	Porte terrasse cassée difficile d’utilisation (problème récurrent d’après autres avis) malgré l’intervention du personnel pendant notre séjour 
	•	Jacuzzi sans protection contre la pollution du Caire, devient très sale rapidement
	•	Très bruyant : claquements de portes et cris en pleine nuit
	•	Seulement 2 capsules café pour plusieurs jours
	•	Trop de messages automatiques et relances pour avoir 5 étoiles

Conclusion :
Potentiel gâché par des problèmes majeurs non résolus. Le manque d’intimité est problématique. Pour ce prix au Caire, on peut trouver mieux.

Le logement correspondait globalement à l’annonce, mais notre séjour a été mitigé.

Le principal point négatif concerne le jacuzzi : l’eau chaude était très compliquée à utiliser, ce qui fait que nous n’avons malheureusement pas pu en profiter, alors qu’il s’agit pourtant d’un atout majeur du logement. L’état de propreté à notre arrivée n’était pas entièrement satisfaisant. La porte extérieure donnant sur la cour avait un verrou défectueux, ce qui ne nous a pas fait nous sentir en sécurité. Les lumières extérieures fonctionnaient très mal voire pas. Le soir, il était donc impossible de profiter de la terrasse sans déplacer une lampe.
Il y avait également beaucoup de moustiques. Nous avions demandé des bougies ou une solution pour pouvoir profiter mais cela a malheureusement été oublié et rien ne nous a été apporté.
Certains éléments visibles sur les photos de l’annonce (plantes, bougies) n’y été pas. Logement bruyant, le prix nous semble excessif. Hôtel très réactif par sms et gentil.

They also went out of their way to help with anything we might need. For example, the jacuzzi was dirty because of a sandstorm the night before, I texted the host about this and in less than 5 minutes the cleaning crew came to fix the issue. Honestly, insane service!

The only negative I can find is that the heating system in the shower was unstable. Always, going between extremely hot and extremely cold temperatures. I hope they fix it. 

To conclude, I would definitely recommend you stay in this apartment it was overall a great experience!
